tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i grub chen ḍombi pa sogs grub thob so so'i bla sgrub dbang gi skabs/ skyabs sems/ 1$0000300na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do:

mchod pa byin rlabs/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rakta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: zhes sngon du 'gro bas/ gter gzhung bzhin bdag mdun bum pa so sor gsal btab la/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: sgom pa dang mtshungs ye shes pa: spyan drangs bdag mdun rnams la thim: bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs kar zla steng rdo rje'i lter// hrīḥmathar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor// de las 'od zer mchod pa'i sprin// phar 'phros rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod// tshur 'dus byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus// snang grags lha sngags chos sku'i ngang*// dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor gyur// zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzla/ mthar mchod bstod spyi 'gre bya/ las bum du rdor sems bskyed bzlas dang*/ rig me dor la gnang ba nod/
